fields.title: Model creation
fields.challenges: -Refined the models too many times initially which led in errors during second migration
fields.lessons: -There needs to be good preparation prior to starting your project regarding to the database schema design
fields.proposed_action: -Design your models and database schema early before production for future projects

fields.title: App layout
fields.challenges: Figuring out the layouts and pages needed in the app
fields.lessons:
-Sketch layouts during the app design phase, such that execution is seamless 
-I need more knowledge on the overall app architectural design process
fields.proposed_action: -Seek tutorials on a general app structure and on layout design
